preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int, type(x)) and -1 <= x < N for x in A)
preconditions.description: A is a list of N integers where each element is either -1 or a non-negative integer less than N.
N is a positive integer and A has exactly N elements.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= x <= N for x in map(int, stdout.strip().split())) and len(map(int, stdout.strip().split())) == N)
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout is a space-separated string of N distinct integers from 1 to N (the lexicographically smallest permutation P).

postconditions.expression: all((A[i] == 0 and all(P[j] < P[i] for j in range(1, i))) or (A[i] != 0 and A[i] == max(j for j in range(1, i) if P[j] > P[i]) if any(P[j] > P[i] for j in range(1, i)) else 0) for i in range(N)) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation P (parsed from stdout) must satisfy the generation rule for every known A[i] (i.e., A[i] != -1). For each i, if P[i] is greater than all previous elements, A[i] must be 0. Otherwise, A[i] must equal the maximum index j < i where P[j] > P[i], or 0 if no such j exists.

postconditions.expression: all(P[i] != P[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N)) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation P (parsed from stdout) must contain all integers from 1 to N exactly once (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(P[i] < P[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N) if (stdout.strip().split().index(str(P[i])) < stdout.strip().split().index(str(P[j])) and P[i] == P[j])) == False) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation P (parsed from stdout) must be lexicographically smallest among all valid permutations.
